description: The acceptance suite: the cells this build claims to run, in the order it runs them. Each manifest carries its own expected evidence, so adding a cell is adding its path here and nothing else — gate G1 eventually needs seven cells at two cohort sizes, and the suite has to grow by declaration rather than by machinery.

same_implementation.why: The aggregation contrast is a contrast of Factor A only if both cells' adapters wired the same executor against the same model over the same transport limits. Unchecked, it could be a comparison of two client implementations wearing cell labels.
